blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City Hall compound was cleared of any explosives after authorities conducted a security sweep following an alleged bomb threat received Thursday night. In a statement late Thursday night, the Quezon City government said it received the threat through a message sent to its official Facebook page from an individual whose identity was not disclosed. “As part of security protocols, authorities immediately conducted sweeping, paneling and inspection inside the Quezon City Hall compound and all its buildings, the statement said.
